microphone.title: Microphone Not Available
microphone.message:
Unable to access your microphone. Please check that:
• Your microphone is connected
• The app has microphone permissions
• No other app is using the microphone

systemAudio.title: System Audio Not Available
systemAudio.message:
Unable to capture system audio. Please check that:
• A virtual audio device (like BlackHole) is installed
• The app has screen recording permissions (macOS)
• System audio is properly configured

permission.title: Permission Required
permission.message:
Recording permissions are required. Please:
• Grant microphone access in System Settings
• Grant screen recording access for system audio (macOS)
• Restart the app after granting permissions

generic.title: Recording Failed
generic.message: Unable to start recording. Please check your audio device settings and try again.

permissions.microphoneDescription: Meetily needs access to your microphone to record meetings. No microphone devices were detected.

microphoneChecks.connected: Your microphone is connected and powered on
microphoneChecks.granted: Microphone permission is granted in System Settings
microphoneChecks.exclusive: No other app is exclusively using the microphone

permissions.systemAudioWithMicrophone: System audio capture is not available. You can still record with your microphone, but computer audio won't be captured.
permissions.systemAudioWithoutMicrophone: System audio capture is also not available.
permissions.macosStepsTitle: To enable system audio on macOS:

macosSteps.virtualDevice: Install a virtual audio device (e.g., BlackHole 2ch)
macosSteps.screenRecording: Grant Screen Recording permission to Meetily
macosSteps.routing: Configure your audio routing in Audio MIDI Setup

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth Playback Detected
bluetooth.description: You're using {{device}} for playback. Recordings may sound distorted or sped up through Bluetooth devices. For accurate review, please use computer speakers or wired headphones.

chunkProgress.complete: Processing completed! All {{total}} chunks have been transcribed.
